adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration iterates existing site setting values and runs `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"` (around lines 24-27). Because `h` is interpolated directly into a SQL string inside single quotes with no escaping/quoting, any host value containing a single quote (or other SQL special chars) will break the SQL and can cause the migration to fail (and is also an injection risk in principle).
